query: WITH changed AS (SELECT project_id,ts,session_id FROM events WHERE received_at>$1 AND received_at<=$2) SELECT DISTINCT e.project_id,date_trunc('hour',e.ts) AS hour FROM events e WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM changed c WHERE c.project_id=e.project_id AND (c.session_id=e.session_id OR c.ts=e.ts)) ORDER BY project_id,hour
